coverage_rationale: Gallagher Bassett is one of several organizations providing expert commentary on the broader industry issue of return-to-work decisions in workers compensation cases.

gb_spokespeople.name: Irina Simpson
gb_spokespeople.title: Executive Vice President of Workers Compensation

gb_statements.speaker: Irina Simpson
gb_statements.text: The opportunity to receive all of the job descriptions and make sure they’re as current as possible is critical

gb_statements.speaker: Irina Simpson
gb_statements.text: If you say light duty, what does that mean?

gb_statements.speaker: Irina Simpson
gb_statements.text: If you say no heavy lifting, is it five pounds? Fifty-five pounds? The definitions can vary.

gb_statements.speaker: Irina Simpson
gb_statements.text: Those outdated documents are often among the first warning signs that a return-to-work program may struggle, said Irina Simpson, Philadelphia-based executive vice president of workers compensation for Gallagher Bassett.

gb_statements.speaker: Irina Simpson
gb_statements.text: Employers with mature return-to-work programs increasingly supplement written job descriptions with photographs, videos and detailed physical demands analyses that show physicians exactly what employees do throughout a workday, Ms. Simpson said (see related story below).

gb_statements.speaker: Irina Simpson
gb_statements.text: Even then, communication can break down, she said.

gb_statements.speaker: Irina Simpson
gb_statements.text: Adjusters may fail to obtain accurate job information, providers may receive incomplete documentation and supervisors may misunderstand medical restrictions when employees return to work.

gb_statements.speaker: Irina Simpson
gb_statements.text: Employers increasingly supplement traditional job descriptions with photographs, videos and predictive analytics that help clinicians visualize job demands, said Irina Simpson, Philadelphia-based executive vice president of workers compensation for Gallagher Bassett.

gb_statements.speaker: Irina Simpson
gb_statements.text: Machine learning models can identify claims that may benefit from earlier clinical intervention, while AI tools are beginning to analyze work restrictions and support return-to-work decisions.

gb_statements.speaker: Irina Simpson
gb_statements.text: Future applications may even recommend accommodations to employers based on physician-recommended restrictions, she said.

key_messages.message: Keeping job descriptions current is critical for effective return-to-work programs.
key_messages.supporting_excerpt: The opportunity to receive all of the job descriptions and make sure they’re as current as possible is critical

key_messages.message: Employers with mature return-to-work programs use detailed physical demands analyses to aid physicians.

key_messages.message: Communication breakdowns can occur even with updated job descriptions, affecting return-to-work outcomes.

key_messages.message: Digital tools and AI are enhancing the connection between employers, adjusters, and medical providers.
